title: Necklaces, subset sums, and cyclic permutations
summary: It is a well known that, for odd $n$, the number of subsets of $\{1,2,\dots,n\}$ the sum of whose elements is divisible by $n$ equals the number of binary necklaces of length $n$. In this paper generalize this result in two directions. On the one hand, we introduce a parameter $r$ so that requiring the subset sums to be congruent to $r$ modulo $n$ translates into imposing some periodicity conditions on the necklaces.
